150 grams of cooked chicken, broiler-fryer, thigh, meat and skin (baked or roasted, unspecified) came from about 217.39 grams (217 g) raw, using the USDA cooking yield of 69%. Use the raw weight with raw nutrition data when you log food or scale a recipe. USDA yield is hot cooked weight divided by raw weight of the same piece, measured in USDA research kitchens; your result moves with doneness, trim, bone and pan juices.
